tasks.title: Look inside the boxes
tasks.starter:
name = "Sam"
age = 12
print(name)
print(age)
print("My name is", name)

hints.spaces: A comma in print() adds one space for you. Don't add another inside the speech marks.

hints.error: Python can't find a box called Score. Look carefully at the capital letter: is the box called score or Score?

hints.other: Speech marks around name make Python print the word name. Take them off to look inside the box.

tests.output: Hi, I'm Ava and I like red

hints.spaces: Let the commas add the spaces. Don't put spaces at the ends of the text inside the speech marks.
hints.other: Use the variables name and colour (no speech marks) inside print().
